We’ve got a few tasty paths you can go down, depending on what you’re after:

Want flexibility? You can customize what’s in your next box and even switch your box type by logging in, going to NEXT BOX → EDIT YOUR BOX → UPDATE CONTENTS, then saving your changes.

Prefer in-store? You can find a limited selection of our cuts fresh in Target meat cases nationwide and some frozen breakfast items in Costco stores in the Pacific Northwest.

So, the best choice depends on whether you want maximum customization, a one-time gift, or just a few essentials in-store. Based on this, you can tweak your box contents, pick a gift box/eGift, or grab select cuts at Target or Costco.
